title: Queen  and  Adam Lambert - You Are The Champions (In Support Of The Covid-19 Solidarity Response Fund)

lines.l: We're committing no crime, and by mistake, I've made it for you
I've had my share of sin kicked in my face, but I've been there
We are the champions, my friends
And we'll keep on fighting to the end
Cause you are the champions of the world
So dear friends, your love is gone
I dare not say as the wind must blow
So a love is lost, a love is won
Go to sleep and dream again
Soon your hopes will rise and then
From all this gloom, life can start anew
And there'll be no crying soon
